zar.definition: A religious set of beliefs and practices in parts of northern Africa and the Middle East, involving the possession of an individual (usually female) by a type of spirit.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zealous.definition: Full of zeal; ardent, fervent; exhibiting enthusiasm or strong passion, particularly in matters of religion.

zebra.definition: Any of three species of subgenus Hippotigris: Equus grevyi, Equus quagga, or Equus zebra, all with black and white stripes and native to Africa.

zodiacs.definition: Form of zodiac (plural): The belt-like region of the celestial sphere, approximately eight degrees north and south of the ecliptic, which includes the apparent path of the sun, moon, and visible planets.

zoilus.definition: A critic characterized as bitter, carping, malignant.
